benchmarks.segment: Sales - in-house statics (Target In-house Sales PageDeck)

benchmarks.warning: CTR 0.03-0.10 pct and CPC $2-11 across all awareness ad sets - the portfolio drag; every ad in the worst-10 list is an Awareness or unscored social ad.

benchmarks.note: Scaled UGC/AI video winners hold 0.45-0.68 thumb-stop; JB-UGC-4-irish peaks at 0.676.

creative_learnings.title: Identity-first hooks win
creative_learnings.detail: Top UGC scripts open with identity - I am a mom, I am 76, I am a sneaker artist, I shop at Target - then follow: Identity, relatable routine or problem, curiosity, product reveal, one meaningful transformation, proof (close-up paint detail or studio process), simple CTA.

creative_learnings.title: Specific curiosity beats withholding
creative_learnings.detail: Rydel July (coffee-ART unboxing, relatable premise) reached 100.5K vs June mystery hook 73.7K, a 36 pct reach lift; skip rate improved even though the product appeared later.

creative_learnings.title: Three organic retention modes
creative_learnings.detail: Comedy earns retention (Maryandbri), authentic messengers lower skip (Nadja, 34 pct skip), educational content wins saves and shares (Jess, artist authority + grail-drop craft).

creative_learnings.title: Hook fixed the funnel in June
creative_learnings.detail: Skip rate fell 57.5 to 45.3 pct May to June; 57 pct passed the hook vs 38; high-intent 75 pct-watched views rose 53 pct (32K to 49K); cost per reach improved $0.065 to $0.057. Only about 6 pct of views reach 75 pct of the video.

creative_learnings.title: Plain-pair-upgrade and grail-drop angles carry paid Sales
creative_learnings.detail: goodbye plain white air force 1 ($2,960 spend, $0.62 per initiate-checkout), collectors quiet grail drop ($2,111, $0.81), factory pair no thanks ($1,446, $0.67), say hello hand-painted panels ($2,010, $0.80), what i bought at target UGC static ($2,847, $0.86) are the scaled winners.

creative_learnings.title: AI videos: high CTR, expensive delivery
creative_learnings.detail: AI video ad set runs CTR 6.7-7.6 pct but CPM $23-24 and $0.90-1.22 per initiate-checkout; woman in car with knickgasm pair scaled to $2,223 at $0.90.

creative_learnings.title: Awareness objective is the drag
creative_learnings.detail: All 10 worst cost-per-result ads with $100+ spend are Awareness/unscored social ads (CPC $2.10-$9.10, CTR 0.03-0.10 pct). Recommendation on the data: reallocate to Sales/Traffic structures that already clear the $0.80 benchmark.

creative_learnings.title: JoinBrands UGC traffic is the cheapest click in the account
creative_learnings.detail: Traffic - UGCset1 (40+ US): 12.18 pct CTR at $0.07 CPC across $1,311 spend; JB-UGC-4-irish alone: 16.37 pct CTR, $0.05 CPC, 0.676 thumb-stop.

executive_overview: The USA paid program sells the KNICKGASM coffee-ART collection through two retail funnels: Target (Meta + TikTok ads into page-deck and PDP funnels, in-house statics + scored JoinBrands UGC + whitelisted influencers) and Costco (dark posts to the Indian diaspora in the US, landing on the Instacart PDP). Paid spend May 1 to July 20 was $45,870.61 (Meta $41,515.53 across 125 ads in 13 campaigns; TikTok $4,355.08, June only). The Sales engine clears its own benchmark ($0.80 per initiate-checkout on in-house statics; $0.73 on influencer page-deck), JoinBrands UGC traffic delivers the cheapest clicks in the account ($0.07), and Awareness structures are the portfolio drag (CTR 0.03-0.10 pct at $2-9 CPC). Organic ran 3.59M views / 1.58M reach Apr to Jul 17 on $150,956 total creator cost (69 influencers, 367 UGC videos; 300+ UGC pieces produced monthly). The creator- performance dashboard is fully automated (JoinBrands + Snowflake + mapping sheet); ad-campaign information is owned by Kritagya Prakash going forward, with Samvita leading paid and Anchit executing Target Meta. A consultant repository (for Megan) collates every report; priority explorations are Spins seasonality, August demos, Ibotta redeemer targeting, and the USA DTC coffee-ART launch email.

Creator economics: 69 influencers at $107,648 (62 live); 367 UGC videos at $43,308 (parked for 400 creators); total creator cost $150,956, utilized $69,948; organic CPR $0.04-0.10.

Retention funnel May vs June (Instagram): skip rate 57.5 to 45.3 pct; passed-hook 38 to 57 pct; 75 pct-watched views +53 pct (32K to 49K); cost per reach $0.065 to $0.057. Only ~6 pct of views reach 75 pct of the video.

Creator learnings: identity-first openers (mom / 76 / sneaker artist / Target shopper); specific curiosity beats withholding (Rydel July +36 pct reach); comedy retains (Maryandbri), authenticity lowers skip (Nadja), education earns saves (Jess).

sop.title: KNICKGASM Ad Campaign SOP — the final standing procedure
sop.scope: Ad execution across UGC, Target, Costco and D2C.
sop.authority: The master tracking sheet is the source of truth. Where the sheet and the SOP differ, the sheet is correct and the SOP is corrected to match. The SOP carries the process; the sheet carries the data.

tabs.holds: Tab guide, row layout, colour coding, setup
Score bands, thresholds, weights, view penalties, run status
Naming syntax, rules, token values, URL parameters
PageDeck destinations by content bucket, with performance
Real-time IMPORTRANGE pull from Vinya's team's sheet
UGC campaigns, 26 columns; landing page differs per campaign
D2C campaigns, 26 columns; every input from Anchit

sop.formula_columns: CTR, CPC, CPA and ROAS are formulas. Inputs are Spend, Impressions, Clicks, Conversions and Revenue. Overwriting a formula cell stops it calculating for every row below. Ad Code is plain text so codes are not converted to currency or scientific notation.

formulas.tiktok: 6-sec View % x 40% + Shares x 25% + (Likes + Comments) x 20% + Views x 15%
formulas.instagram: Views x 40% + Likes x 35% + Comments x 15%  (sums to 90%, under review with Samvita; the Organic Score column is authoritative until resolved)

tiktok_weights.why: Strongest signal - hook worked, TikTok rewards this directly
Viral intent - the highest organic endorsement
Active engagement; comments = a real reaction
Reach without resonance - deliberately the smallest weight

instagram_weights.why: Reach indicates the algorithm is distributing the content
Rarer on Instagram, strong when present

bands.label: Elite
bands.meaning: Top-tier organic. Strong hook, high retention, real engagement. First to boost.

bands.label: High
bands.meaning: Solid hold and engagement. Boost with confidence.

bands.label: Good
bands.meaning: Meets the Ad Recommended threshold. Worth testing with budget.

scoring.six_second_rule: A 6-sec view rate of 25% or above auto-qualifies a TikTok post regardless of total score - a hook holding past six seconds has already beaten the platform's skip behaviour.

view_penalties.why: Sample too small to be reliable

run_status.note: Two columns look similar; only one is an instruction. Ad Recommended = scoring output. Ads Activated = the run instruction. No ad goes live unless Ads Activated reads 'Review before running ads'.

values.meaning: Cleared Level 2, queued for the agency
values.action: Review spelling, grammar and formatting, then set live

nomenclature.principle: One syntax everywhere. The string entered into the platform as a campaign, ad set or ad name is the same string carried in the URL as a UTM value. There is no second, human-readable form.
nomenclature.character_set: Lowercase only. Underscore between fields. Hyphen inside a field. Dates as yyyy-mm-dd.

patterns.syntax: yyyy-mm-dd _ type _ product _ audience _ surface _ videoid

nomenclature.macros: Where Meta provides one, the macro is used rather than the literal string: {{campaign.name}}, {{adset.name}}, {{ad.name}}, {{site_source_name}}. acq_source and acq_subsource have no macro and are copied from the sheet row.
nomenclature.costco_note: Costco runs on TikTok, giving utm_source tiktok-tiktok and acq_source costco_tiktok.

rules.rule: No space, /, comma, &, ?, %, + or # in any name or parameter
rules.consequence: Space becomes %20, slash %2F, comma breaks CSV export, & and ? break the query string, # truncates the URL
GA4 and several platform APIs are case-sensitive; mixed case splits one campaign across multiple report rows

rules.rule: videoid mandatory on every ad name and inside utm_content
rules.consequence: The ad cannot be mapped to its organic performance

rules.rule: acq_subsource carries creator, bucket and hook
rules.consequence: Revenue by creator, content angle and hook style is unavailable

rules.rule: Target and Costco names kept strictly separate
rules.consequence: Reporting overlap; Costco campaigns have previously been built using Target keywords
One mistyped token splits a single audience across two report rows

rules.rule: Names in Ad Manager match the tracker exactly

tokens.bucket: grail-drop laces-vs-custom target-shelf anti-factory paint-detail over40-high-performer target-instore
tokens.hook: curiosity problem-pain age-stage personal-discovery comparison callout-ifyou lifestyle paint-sensory

landing_pages.principle: UGC ads route to a dedicated PageDeck page built for that content angle, not to the product page. Each new UGC campaign receives its own page. Anchit supplies the URL with the brief and it is used as given - the generic product page is not substituted, because the page is the attribution.

pages.note: Target PDP direct. No PageDeck page at present.

landing_pages.reconciliation: Traffic reconciles: 23,570 ad clicks against 25,594 visitors across the six UGC bucket pages (92% match) - the pages are receiving the paid traffic correctly and the remainder is organic.
landing_pages.conversion_gap: Those pages produced 10,165 external clicks onward, yet PageDeck reports 0 conversions and $0 revenue on every page. Purchases complete on target.com, instacart.com or Shopify - outside PageDeck's visibility - so zero is EXPECTED on retail destinations. For any page routing to knickgasm.com it is NOT expected and points to a missing pixel or goal.
open_items: Two pages carrying 7,111 visitors between them are still truncated in the PageDeck export as 'coffee-cta...cer-target' - full slugs needed before they can be attributed.
targetstore vs targetshelf is not a mismatch: both exist, targetstore carries the live traffic (3,875 visitors), targetshelf is an alternate with 1 visitor. Use targetstore.

campaign_tab_columns.column: Target Audience Criteria Set for Campaign

campaign_tab_columns.by: Anchit. New page per campaign for UGC.

ugc_flow.owns: The master UGC sheet and all organic data: creator post, URL, platform, publish date, content bucket, views, likes, comments, shares, 2-sec and 6-sec view rates, average view time, engagement rate.
ugc_flow.function: Accuracy at source, and the first quality filter on whether a post is usable.
ugc_flow.dependency: The tracker pulls from this sheet live. An error here passes directly into scoring and then into what the agency runs. No manual checkpoint exists in between.

ugc_flow.owns: The scoring decision, the Ads Activated column, all landing pages and URL parameters, and the full brief for D2C.
ugc_flow.function: Each post is scored with the formula and view penalties, checked against the platform threshold, and marked in Ads Activated. Clearing sets 'Review before running ads'; failing sets 'No'.
ugc_flow.dependency: The decision is quantitative, not creative. Level 2 does not assess whether a video is good - it checks whether the market has already indicated so.

ugc_flow.level: Level 3 — Kanish and the Bharat Maven team
ugc_flow.owns: The final quality check, campaign build, naming, launch and performance reporting.
ugc_flow.function: Everything marked 'Review before running ads' is checked for spelling, grammar, on-screen text, formatting and aspect ratio, then built and named per the Nomenclature standard and taken live. Ad Code, Ad Link and Ad Report Link filled on going live; performance within 72 hours.
ugc_flow.dependency: Strategic input expected additionally: where a creative clears the threshold but reads weak, or a pattern appears across creatives, that observation forms part of the deliverable.

budgets.rules: Budgets are entered in the Budget column as a daily figure. Nothing is agreed verbally. A row without a budget in the sheet is not ready to build.
budgets.target_cap: Target spend cap $1,000 per day, paced with automated rules in Meta. Directive agreed with Bala; corrects the $1,700 spike on 19 July. Overpacing is flagged proactively.

required_before_build: Ad To Be Run (Brief) - one or two lines on purpose and intended outcome
Placement / Format - IG Reels, IG Stories, FB Feed, TikTok In-Feed or Advantage+
Product / SKU - the exact product advertised
Target Audience - selected from the dropdown
Target Audience Criteria - the actual targeting, e.g. 'Age 40+, Interests: Business, Streetwear'
Creative Link - opens without a permission request (Sudhanshu)
Landing Page URL - full URL including all UTM and acquisition parameters (Anchit)
Ads Activated - set to 'Review before running ads' once Level 2 clears (Anchit)

automation.chain: organic post URL -> videoid -> ad name -> ad code -> paid performance
automation.how: The video id is taken from the end of the organic video URL, appears at the end of every ad name and therefore inside utm_content. When the agency enters the Ad Code for a live ad, the backend matches the ad code to the video id inside the ad name, and the video id back to its row in the Master UGC Tracker. Organic and paid join automatically - no manual matching, no lookups.
makes_measurable: Whether a high organic score predicts better paid performance
Which content buckets return best against spend
Which creators drive revenue rather than views
automation.warning: An ad name without the video id still runs, but is excluded from the analysis, and the spend on it produces no learning.
automation.acq_subsource: Carries creator _ bucket _ hook, so one split on the underscore returns revenue attributed by creator, content angle and hook style directly from the URL.

turnaround.step: Brief and creative complete in the sheet
Ads Activated set after Level 2 scoring
Ad Code, Ad Link, Ad Report Link

standing_conditions.handles: All ads run from KNICKGASM brand handles. Creator post URLs in the tracker are performance reference only.
standing_conditions.build_state: Campaigns are built paused. Spend begins only after Level 2 clearance and row approval.

ad_accounts_registry.kpi_rule: Accounts are not comparable on one KPI. Where a pixel or Google conversion is tracked, revenue/ROAS/CPA are real. Where checkout happens on target.com, Instacart or amazon.com, no purchase can ever be attributed, so those accounts report null rather than 0 and must be judged on CTR, CPC, CPM and reach. A 0.00x ROAS on a retail account is a measurement artefact, not a result.
ad_accounts_registry.currency_rule: India reports INR and UK reports GBP. Never sum them with the USD accounts.
